normalization_context.meaning: Existing service strips and drops blanks, preserves duplicates/order. Builder receives exact stored lists; it never repeats normalization.

handwritten_python_cases: Reject int/dict/list/str subclasses under strict built-in checks
Reject unpaired surrogate strings through content-free error
Reject cyclic input through content-free error
Builders leave inputs unchanged and return no mutable aliases
No clock, IO, Store, HTTP parser or publisher access
